evaluations_submitted_complete.name: evaluations_submitted_complete
evaluations_submitted_complete.value: ("evaluations"."status" = 'draft' AND "evaluations"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "evaluations"."submitted_by" IS NULL) OR ("evaluations"."status" = 'submitted' AND "evaluations"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "evaluations"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "evaluations"."recommendation" IS NOT NULL)

published_has_number.name: published_has_number
published_has_number.value: ("question_versions"."status" = 'published') = ("question_versions"."version" IS NOT NULL AND "question_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

room_hidden_output_not_stored.name: room_hidden_output_not_stored
room_hidden_output_not_stored.value: NOT "room_test_results"."is_hidden" OR ("room_test_results"."stdout" IS NULL AND "room_test_results"."stderr" IS NULL)

rooms_name_length.name: rooms_name_length
rooms_name_length.value: "rooms"."name" IS NULL OR char_length(btrim("rooms"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

hidden_output_not_stored.name: hidden_output_not_stored
hidden_output_not_stored.value: NOT "test_results"."is_hidden" OR ("test_results"."stdout" IS NULL AND "test_results"."stderr" IS NULL)
